The area products of inertia measure the asymmetry of a cross-section’s area distribution with respect to a pair of perpendicular axes

The three area products of inertia for a solid $S$ according to orthonormal base $B$ is:

$$
I_{xy} = \int_A {x}{y}\ dA;\ \
I_{xz} = \int_A {x}{z}\ dA;\ \
I_{yz} = \int_A {y}{z}\ dA.
$$

== Parallel axes theorem ==

$$
I_{xy} = I_{x'y'} + A \bar{x}\bar{y}
$$
